purpose: Enclosed region-independent interiors. Preserve approved scene and hero; remove exterior tower views.

This room must work in any region of a tower with NO view outside whatsoever. Preserve the composition, same canvas aspect ratio3:1, hero exact back-facing pose and size, face, hat, clothing, backpack, boots, workbench, ammunition press, warm lamp, floor and every central prop. Keep the existing pixel cluster density, muted palette and warm/cool balance; no extra detail, no new text/UI. Do not redesign the scene or shift the hero. Retain enough indoor teal value contrast to avoid a black featureless room.
entries.review: No outside view; hero/bench composition visually retained. Outfit still baked into scene.
